name: Action Log
description: A running log of what an agent has done, one row per action, with the newest row in progress.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; kind: "search" | "read" | "write" | "run" | "think"; label: ReactNode; detail?: ReactNode; status: "running" | "done" | "failed" | "skipped" }[]
props.description: The actions in order. The kind picks the icon, the label is the verb, and the detail is a file or source name shown as a monospaced chip. A running row has a passing band of light and a timer; when it finishes, the timer keeps its final time. A failed row turns camellia and says "Failed"; a skipped row is struck through and says "Skipped".

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the list. Other props, such as aria-label, go to the ol element, which is a polite live region for new rows.
